GlobalSecondaryIndexes.Purpose: Allows querying all URLs sorted by creation time for the admin dashboard

Notes.PrimaryKey: shortCode is the partition key — every lookup is by shortCode, giving O(1) speed.
Notes.TTL: expiryAt stores a Unix timestamp. DynamoDB TTL auto-deletes items when current time exceeds this value.
Notes.ClickCount: clickCount uses DynamoDB UpdateItem with ADD operation for atomic, thread-safe increment.
Notes.GSI: GSI on createdAt allows querying all URLs in chronological order for admin views.
